note: wait reads a drive path: file:, exit: and marker: conditions and the file: guard take an optional drive prefix (a letter and a colon right before / or \), as Claude Code hands on Windows. On macOS and Linux C: is a folder of the cwd, so the grammar is the same on every OS. marker:x:a:b is still path x with regex a:b, and file:C:x (no separator after the colon) matches no kind
